cards.title: The shard
cards.text: You marked the shard a problem: 'Uh huh. Sure...'. What's wrong with it?
cards.why: I can't tell if you don't see it in your game, or you see it and don't like it.
cards.details: The clip is the game now: the gold star with a darker one turning the other way underneath. Shards aren't placed when Practice build is on, which could be why it never showed.

options.label: Never see it
options.text: It doesn't show up in my game.

options.label: Still ugly
options.text: I see it and the look is still wrong.

options.label: Too small
options.text: It's there but easy to miss.

cards.title: A fourth cast
cards.text: The design has two more shapes. Which becomes the fourth cast, with its own button?
cards.why: Every module then needs an answer on that shape too, so it's a big piece of work.

options.label: Burst
options.text: A thrown bomb that blasts where it lands.

options.label: Beam
options.text: A held beam that sweeps and burns through.
